notes.title: Sword Reverie 1.0 Update
notes.content:
Now is a great time to jump back into Sword Reverie 

🔥 Unique skills and strategy: Discover 16 unique player skills and 12 challenging enemy skills. Optimized skills and player skill cooldowns to allow more combos and strategic choices. 

⚡ Optimized early levels so you can get to the fun faster!

🌸Japanese VO and subtitles in English, Japanese, and Chinese (simplified/Traditional). Play in the language of your choice and get the full anime experience. 

🐞 Game optimization: We’ve greatly improved the game's performance, added many new small features, and fixed a ton of bugs including but not limited

 Added comfort settings
 Better indication when hitting enemy armor. 
 Better skill swap UI
 Issues with using teleport after level 6
 Correctly unlocking a weapon after completing level 12. 


As always, thank you for checking out our game again and we hope to bring you more exciting updates soon!

notes.title: Black Friday Update
notes.content:
Minor new featuers, bug fixes, and performance optimizations


 Added support for LIV SDK
 Improved character shaders
 Allow players to cancel enemy's skills with knockback
 Fixed bugs and optimized performance for certain skills
 Fixed some issues with skill sound effects when pausing and restarting

notes.title: Major update to player and enemy skills
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard behind the scenes since our last update, and we’re thrilled to announce major new updates after having heard your feedback!

🔥  Diversified gameplay: Discover 16 unique new player skills - we have doubled our previous skill set! Each skill is designed to enhance your strategies and challenge you against even the toughest enemies. Get ready to double the fun and tactics in every battle!

🌟  Fresh enemy combat: More intense combat experience than ever! We’ve boosted the difference between enemy elements by introducing 9 new enemy skills, each unique to the enemy class and element. 

🎨  Visual upgrades: We have upgraded our character shaders and enemy death VFX to bring you strong thrills with each victory.

🐞 Game optimization: We’ve addressed various performance issues and bugs to ensure better stability.


We hope you’ll enjoy this round of updates! As always, there’s more to look out for, we thank you for your continued support, stay tuned for more from the Sword Reverie Team!

notes.title: 0.8.9 Early Access Update 1.5
notes.content:
New features:

 Added volume settings, including the ability to change music, voice-over, and sound effect volume independently. 
 Improved Magnus AI to attack enemies in more cases during Chapters 2 and 4 (we will continue improving NPC AI in future updates).

Bug fixes and balance changes:

 Fixed issue with menus blocking each other in Guild Hall.

notes.title: Early Access Update 1 Now Available
notes.content:
0.8.8 Early Access Update 1

The first update for Sword Reverie Early Access is here! 

New features:

 Improved Magnus AI to attack enemies in certain cases (we will continue improving Magnus AI in the next update).
 Players now receive exp and items when killed.
 Added sitting mode and height calibration options (decide how tall or short you want to be).
 Added setting for snap / smooth turn speed.

Bug fixes and balance changes:

 Reduced drag on player swords (allows the sword to more closely track player hand movement)
 Reduce the slow time effect duration after hitting an enemy.
 Increase Elemental and Humanoid enemy movement speed and attack speed.
 Fixed issue where certain Steam achievements aren’t being correctly set.
 Fixed issue when Humanoid enemy swinging down still damages player after the attack finished.
 Fixed issue where the player can stun-lock enemies on the ground. Enemies get up more quickly after being knocked to the ground and can not be knocked down again for a certain duration after getting up. 
 Player hands are better posed around Swords in a grip pose. 
 Improved player forearm IK to reduce player arm twisting. 
 Fixed issue where certain sound effects would play repeatedly when switching between guild hall and levels. 


We are working on many more improvements based on your feedback and will continue to have updates every 1~2 months.

Select items from Roadmap for next 1~3 months:


 Improve Magnus AI to fight enemies on more levels.
 Improve Ranged Enemy AI so they run away at a slower speed than when running towards you so players can catch up to them and kill them when they are running away. i
 Add volume settings.
 Change health and mana potions so players can choose when to use them (from the pause menu) instead of consuming them as soon as the player receives them.
 Add checkpoints to certain longer levels so players do not need to restart the whole level when they die.
 Add potion crafting.
 Add vignette comfort option.
 Add additional movement options (run, dash, jump).
 Add Japanese VO.
 Add Chinese and Japanese UI.
 Add subtitles (in English, Chinese, and Japanese).

notes.title: 0.8.6 Early Access Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug fixes and balance changes:

 Fixed issue where players can’t move controller after completing a level when turning using smooth turn.

notes.title: 0.8.5 Early Access Week 1 Patch
notes.content:
Bug fixes and balance changes:

 Reduced memory usage by 40%+ and reduced memory-related crashes 
 Improve performance on 16GB RAM machines
 Reduce crashing on machines with <8GB page files
 Baked vegetation to reduce memory usage
 Optimized textures
 Delay loading of voice-over dialogue
 Added logs to end of level win menu to help debug issues with players not being able to move controllers after completing a level. New logs will help us resolve the issue if players continue to experience it in the future
 Fixed bug causing mana regen only once per two hits instead of once per hit. 
 Fixed bug where Stella and Magnus VO were not properly spatialized.

notes.title: Early Access Delay and Alpha Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Unfortunately, Spring 2021 has come and gone :( We did not finish Sword Reverie Early Access development in time for our original Early Access launch date. We are still hard at work on the game, and the new Early Acess date will be later this year. We will announce the specific date as soon as we finish development. 

In the meantime, Kickstarter backers are able to play the latest alpha version of the game. Our latest alpha build (0.7.3) has been completed. The build features a brand new ranged variant of the Elemental Spirit, our first ranged enemy type. 

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/308/701/5823b4d2f54909af494fc9d381f1e4cb_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1627164658&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=85d689bbe702d5ab77afb8fdb8c46632

Defeat the ranged elemental spirit from afar or block their ranged attack with your sword until you can get closer. 0.7.3 also has two additional levels. Level 6 introduces you to the ranged elemental. Level 7 allows you to investigate outposts to track down the Elemental Centaur.

Lots of the voice acting are still placeholders which we will replace soon. We also had some regressions on the sound effects in this build which we are working to resolve. Please bear with us. 

If you have played the alpha, please complete our survey to let us know your thoughts!

Survey

We plan on releasing another 1 or 2 alpha builds before we consider the content of the game ready for Beta. We are working hard to wrap up the development of all the content we had planned for Early Access. Your patience allows us to ensure that when we release in Early Access, Sword Reverie becomes the starting point for an exciting adventure. 

However, development doesn’t end there. We have additional enemies, abilities, weapons, bosses, and even graphics improvements planned ahead.
